child_tool_info.description: Test a supplied metabolic model with selected reaction bounds or objective, returning the requested objective value or reaction fluxes.
child_tool_info.instructions: Use the assigned question and model, together with any supplied hypothesis, evidence and reaction correspondence. For an assigned reaction knockout, set both bounds of that existing model reaction to zero. Select SBML or COBRA JSON input, optional bounds for existing reactions, and either the model's objective or one existing reaction as objective. Objective direction is retained. Describe an objective as growth only when the supplied model/question identifies it as growth or biomass. Return requested objective values or named reaction fluxes with relevant conditions and diagnostic qualifications through the existing FBA result forms and calculators. Predictions remain conditional on the supplied model and correspondence. Saved-sheet recalculation changes supported diagnostics/projections; changed models, bounds, or objectives require new selected native work.
